## Architecture check

Applicable guides: [api-dtos-and-validation.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md), [security.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/security.md), [nestjs-patterns.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/nestjs-patterns.md), [best-practices.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/best-practices.md), [module-structure.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/module-structure.md), [caching-and-performance.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/caching-and-performance.md), [testing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md), [commits-and-prs.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md), [remarks.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md).

1. **[ValidationPipe everywhere](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md#L11)** — [src/modules/messages/routes/messages.controller.ts:66](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/6fadd78f1482f5c31dd38499eed962686b10d2dc/src/modules/messages/routes/messages.controller.ts#L66) — the four new `chainId` pipes (lines 66, 103, 147, 192) use bare `NumericStringSchema`, which the rule marks as pre-`ChainIdSchema` drift and 'not precedent to extend'. **Fix:** add `import { ChainIdSchema } from '@/modules/chains/domain/entities/schemas/chain-id.schema';`, drop the `NumericStringSchema` import, and write each param as `@Param('chainId', new ValidationPipe(ChainIdSchema)) chainId: string,`.
2. **[PR body](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md#L84)** — PR description — the body carries `## Problem`, `## Cause`, `## Impact`, `## Verification` and `## Follow-up` and has no `## Summary`, where the rule allows exactly the template's two sections. **Fix:** keep only `## Summary` (folding the Problem/Cause/Impact/Verification/Follow-up prose into it) and `## Changes`.
3. **[Scopes](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md#L49)** — PR title — the title scopes the change to `(messages)` while it also changes shared infrastructure, [src/datasources/config-api/config-api.service.ts:79](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/6fadd78f1482f5c31dd38499eed962686b10d2dc/src/datasources/config-api/config-api.service.ts#L79), which the rule says omits the scope. **Fix:** retitle to `fix: reject an empty chainId instead of returning 502`.

**Verdict:** ❌ 3 finding(s)
